```{r}
#| label: fig-dropout
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-cap: "Comparisons of baseline characteristics between treatment groups in participants included/excluded from complete-case analysis. Error bars show minimum and maximum values together with first and thirt quartile, points are medians. P-values from comparisons of average differences between included/excluded and treatment with inclusion interactions."


# Test if drop-outs differ from the rest
library(nlme)
library(marginaleffects)






dat <- criteria_dat |> 
  inner_join(idkeys |> 
               select(participant, completed)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = analyte, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(age, HDL:HOMA2IR), 
               names_to = "name", 
               values_to = "value") |> 
  # Compare baseline values
  filter(time == "T1") |> 
  # Standardize 
  mutate(
    .by = name,
    value_std = if_else(name %in% c("TG", "HOMA2IR"), log(value), value), 
    value_std = (value_std - mean(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(value_std, na.rm = TRUE) 
  )
  
  
  


names <- unique(dat$name) 
results <- list()
comp <- list()




for(i in seq_along(names)) {
  
  dat_temp <- dat |>
    filter(name == names[i]) |>
    mutate(included = if_else(participant %in% participant_complete, "incl", "excl"), 
           sex = factor(sex, levels = c("f", "m"))) |> 
    # fail-safe remove na
    filter(!is.na(value))

  
  m <- nlme::gls(value_std ~ included + sex, 
                 weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1|included*sex),
                 data = dat_temp)


  m2 <- nlme::gls(value_std ~ included*treat + sex, 
                 weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1|included*sex),
                 data = dat_temp)


 comp[[i]] <-  data.frame(predictions(m2, newdata = expand_grid(included = c( "incl", "excl"), 
                                                    treat = c("omega", "ctrl"), 
                                                    sex = c("m", "f")), 
                         by = c("included", "treat"))) |>
    mutate(name = names[i])
  
  
  results[[i]] <- cbind(name = names[i],
                   comp = "included vs. excluded",
                   data.frame(est = coef(summary(m))[2,1], 
                   se = coef(summary(m))[2,2], 
                   tval = coef(summary(m))[2,3], 
                   pval = coef(summary(m))[2,4],
                   pval.treat.interact = coef(summary(m2))[5,4]),
        data.frame(lwr = intervals(m)$coef[2,][1], 
                   upr = intervals(m)$coef[2,][3])) |>
    data.frame(row.names = NULL) 
  
  
}


stats <- bind_rows(results)  %>%
  select(name, pval, pval.treat.interact) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("age", 
                                        "waist",
                                        "glucose",
                                        "HOMA2IR",
                                        "bp",
                                        "TG", 
                                        "HDL", 
                                        "fat.rel",
                                        "bmi" ), 
                       labels = c("Age", 
                                  
                                  "Waist circumference",
                                  "Resting glucose" ,
                                  "HOMA2-IR",
                                  "Blood pressure", 
                                  "Triglycerides", 
                                  "HDL Cholesterol", 
                                  "Relative fat mass", 
                                  "Body mass index"))) %>%
  mutate(pval = sprintf("%.3f",round(pval, 3)), 
         pval.treat.interact = sprintf("%.3f",round(pval.treat.interact,3))) 




dat |>
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("age", 
                                        "waist",
                                        "glucose",
                                        "HOMA2IR",
                                        "bp",
                                        "TG", 
                                        "HDL", 
                                        "fat.rel",
                                        "bmi" ), 
                       labels = c("Age", 
                                  
                                  "Waist circumference",
                                  "Resting glucose" ,
                                  "HOMA2-IR",
                                  "Blood pressure", 
                                  "Triglycerides", 
                                  "HDL Cholesterol", 
                                  "Relative fat mass", 
                                  "Body mass index")), 
         sex = factor(sex, levels = c("m", "f"), 
                      labels = c("Male", "Female"))) |>
      mutate(included = if_else(participant %in% participant_complete, 
                                "incl", "excl")) |> 
  
  filter(time == "T1") |> 
  
  
  summarise(.by = c(included, treat, name), 
            m = median(value, na.rm = TRUE), 
            q25 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
            q75 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 
            min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE)) |>


  
  inner_join(stats) %>%
  mutate(name = if_else(name == "Age", 
                        paste(name, 
                      "<br><span style = 'color:#0072B2; font-size:12px;'>Incl vs. Excl: p = ",
                      pval, 
                      "</span><br><span style = 'color:#D55E00; font-size:12px;'>Treat interact: p = ",
                      pval.treat.interact, 
                      "</span>"),
                        paste(name, 
                      "<br><span style = 'color:#0072B2; font-size:12px;'>p = ",
                      pval, 
                      "</span><br><span style = 'color:#D55E00; font-size:12px;'>p = ",
                      pval.treat.interact, 
                      "</span>"))) |> 

  mutate(treat = if_else(treat == "omega", "N-3", "Placebo")) |>
  
  mutate(grp = paste(treat, included)) |> 

  ggplot(aes(grp, m,
             group = grp,
             color = treat, 
             alpha = included)) + 
  
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = min, ymax = max), width = 0, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), width = 0, linewidth = 2, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.2), 
             shape = 22, fill = "white", color = "black")  +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.45, 0.9), guide = "none") +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(colscale[1], colscale[4])) +
  
  theme_classic() + 
  facet_wrap(~ name, scales = "free_x", 
             ncol = 3) + 
  coord_flip() +
    theme_classic() + 
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"), 
        strip.text = element_markdown(hjust = 0), 
        legend.title = element_blank(), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(),
        axis.title = element_text(), 
        legend.position = "bottom")
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-dropout2
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-cap: "Drop-out analysis of baseline characteristics. Estimates show differences in baseline characteristics between included and excluded participants in complete-case analysis (included vs. excluded). Error bars are 95% CI. P-values from average differences between included and excluded, treatment interaction indicate interaction between treatment groups and drop-out." 



bind_rows(results) |> 
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("age", 
                                        "waist",
                                        "glucose",
                                        "HOMA2IR",
                                        "bp",
                                        "TG", 
                                        "HDL", 
                                        "fat.rel",
                                        "bmi" ), 
                       labels = c("Age", 
                                  
                                  "Waist circumference",
                                  "Resting glucose" ,
                                  "HOMA2-Insulin resistance",
                                  "Blood pressure", 
                                  "Triglycerides", 
                                  "HDL Cholesterol", 
                                  "Relative fat mass", 
                                  "Body mass index"))) |> 
  
  mutate(stat_incl = paste("p = ", 
                           sprintf("%.3f",round(pval, 3) )), 
         stat_interact = paste("p = ", 
                               sprintf("%.3f",round(pval.treat.interact, 3)))) |>
  

  
  mutate(stat_incl = if_else(name == "Body mass index", paste("Included vs. excluded: ", stat_incl), stat_incl), 
         stat_interact= if_else(name == "Body mass index", paste("Treatment interaction: ", stat_interact), stat_interact)) |>
  
           ggplot(aes(name, est)) + 
   geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2, color = "gray30") +
           geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), 
                         width = 0.1) +
  
  geom_text(aes(name, Inf, label = stat_incl), 
            vjust = -1, 
            hjust = 1, 
            color = colscale[1]) +
    geom_text(aes(name, Inf, label = stat_interact), 
            vjust = 1, 
            hjust = 1, 
            color = colscale[4]) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  
            geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3,
                       fill = colscale[2], size = 2) + 
  


      theme_classic() + 
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"), 
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0), 
        legend.title = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "bottom") + 
  coord_flip() +
  labs(y = "Included vs. excluded (standardized units)", 
       x = "")
```

```{r}




## Set up loop to model fatty acids 
target <- d |> 
  distinct(fa) |> 
  pull(fa)



coefs <- list()
preds <- list()

for(i in seq_along(target)) {
  
  dsub <- d |> 
  filter(fa == target[i]) |> 
    mutate(lnvalue = log(value))
  
  
  # Fit model log-transformed data
  m <- lmerTest::lmer(lnvalue ~ time + time:treat + (1|participant), 
                      data = dsub)
  
  out <- bind_rows(
    broom.mixed::tidy(m, conf.int = TRUE), 
    marginaleffects::avg_comparisons(m, variables = "treat", by = "time", 
                                   transform = function(x) 100  * (exp(x) - 1)) |> 
    data.frame() |> 
    mutate(effect = "comp", 
           group = NA, 
           std.error = NA, 
           statistic = NA, 
           df = NA, 
           term = paste0(contrast,":", time)) |> 
    select(effect, 
           group,
          term,
           estimate,
           std.error, 
           statistic, 
           df, 
           conf.low, 
           conf.high) 
    ) |> 
    mutate(fa = target[i]) |> 
    select(fa, effect:conf.high)
  
  

  
  
  coefs[[i]] <- out
  preds[[i]] <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m, variables = c("time", "treat"), 
                                   transform = "exp", 
                                   conf_level = 0.99) |> 
    mutate(fa = target[i]) |> 
    data.frame()
  
}


res <- bind_rows(coefs)

preds <- bind_rows(preds) |> 
  mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3")))




stats  <- res |> 
  filter(term %in% c("timeT2:treatomega", "timeT4:treatomega")) |> 
  select(fa, term, p.value) |> 
  mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p.value), 
         sign = if_else(fdr < 0.05, "*", ""), 
         term = gsub("time", "", term), 
         term = gsub(":treatomega", "", term)) |> 
  select(fa, time = term, p.value, sign) |> 
  inner_join(preds |> 
  summarise(.by = c(time, fa), 
  m = max(estimate))) |> 
  inner_join(d |> 
  summarise(.by = c(fa), 
          m.obs = quantile(value, 0.95))) |> 
  mutate(sign.place = m + ((m.obs - m) / 2))




AOData::omega3  |>
  inner_join(idkeys) |>
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2", "T4")) |>
  select(participant, time, treat, C16:C226n3) |>
  pivot_longer(cols =  C16:C226n3, 
               names_to = "fa", 
               values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) |> 
  
  
  ggplot(aes(time, value, color = treat, group = paste(participant, fa))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2) + 
  
  ## Add model predictions

  geom_errorbar(data = preds, 
                aes(time, estimate, 
                    ymin = conf.low, 
                    ymax = conf.high, 
                    group = treat,
                    color = NULL), 
                width = 0.1, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  
  geom_line(data = preds, 
            aes(time, estimate, group = treat, color = NULL), 
            alpha = 1, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
    geom_point(data = preds, 
             aes(time, estimate, fill = treat, group = NULL),
             color = "black",
             size = 3,
             alpha = 1,
             shape = 21, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  # Plot statistical significance 
  geom_text(data = stats, 
            aes(time, sign.place, label = sign, 
                color = NULL, group = NULL),
        size = 6,
        show.legend = FALSE) + 

  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colscale) +
  
   facet_wrap(~ fa, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  
  labs(y = "Fatty acid concentration (&mu;g ml<sup>-1</sup>)", 
       x = "Time point", 
       fill = "Treatment", 
       color = "Treatment") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_markdown(), 
        strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"),   
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 12), 
        legend.position = "inside", 
        legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.1))
```
